statements.quote: Density functional theory (DFT) calculations indicate the potential stability of TMDC alloys with various compositions in both the 1T and 2H phases. statements.attributed: developed the projector augmented wave (PAW) method
statements.quote: All DFT calculations were performed using the projector augmented wave (PAW) method as implemented in the GPAW electronic structure code, with the Perdew–Burke–Ernzerhof (PBE) exchange-correlation functional. statements.attributed: proposed the mixed enthalpy–entropy descriptor (MEED)
statements.quote: To further verify the synthesizability of the predicted alloys, we calculated a mixed enthalpy–entropy descriptor (MEED) as an additional metric. MEED integrates two critical parameters that capture the thermodynamic and configurational characteristics affecting HEA stability.
